item.title: Mangal Dosha (Kuja Dosha) in Vedic Astrology: Classical Basis, Effects, Cancellation and Remedies
item.description: A source-grounded look at Mangal Dosha (Kuja Dosha/Manglik Dosha) — what the classical texts and well-known astrologers actually say, how it is calculated, when it is cancelled, and what remedies have real textual standing.
